newsitem.title: UK: Talk of BoE stg intervention but traders sceptical.
newsitem.headline: Talk of BoE stg intervention but traders sceptical.

text.p: There was some talk in the foreign exchange markets this morning that the Bank of England was intervening to take the steam out of sterling/dollar but many traders were sceptical.
The talk was that the Bank sold sterling around $1.6750 and it was at that point cable fell around half a cent. But many traders were of the opinion that it was not intervention.
"There was talk the Bank was in but I don't see why they should have been particularly," said one trader.
"And even if they were in the market you mustn't forget they do deal for customers," he added.
At 1256 GMT the pound was at $1.6698/08 versus Monday's close of $1.6825/35. On the mark it was at 2.6107/18 against a previous 2.5972/82.
